title: Nvidia Invests $1.5B in SoftBank Data Center Developer Linked to OpenAI
summary: Nvidia announced a $1.5 billion investment in SB Energy, a data center developer backed by SoftBank and OpenAI. The deal makes Nvidia the exclusive supplier of compute infrastructure for OpenAI’s Ports-Pike data center in Ohio, with potential expansion from 4.25 GW to 8 GW. Nvidia will also extend up to $105 billion in credit for construction. The project includes a $33 billion natural gas power plant on a former uranium enrichment site, reflecting rising energy costs and potential future competition for natural gas resources.
key_points: Nvidia will invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy, a data center developer linked to SoftBank and OpenAI.
Nvidia becomes the sole supplier of compute infrastructure for OpenAI’s Ports-Pike data center in Ohio.
The data center may scale from 4.25 GW to 8 GW, with Nvidia providing up to $105 billion in credit for construction.
SB Energy will build a 9.2 GW natural gas power plant on a former U.S. Department of Energy uranium enrichment site.
The $33 billion power plant cost reflects a 66% increase in natural gas plant construction expenses over the past two years.
Future competition for natural gas could triple prices in some U.S. regions.
